D=/tmp/morph/percent-of-m1; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp calc/percent_of.go $D/0-$S.go 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 export NO_COLOR=1 CI=1
export GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-/tmp/morph/go-build}" GOPATH="${GOPATH:-/tmp/morph/go}"
P=$PWD/probe/percent-of; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; trap 'rm -rf $P calc/percent-of_probe_test.go' EXIT
cat > $P/guard.mjs <<'MORPH_GUARD_EOF'
// guard
MORPH_GUARD_EOF
cat > $P/firstdiff.mjs <<'MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF'
// firstdiff
MORPH_FIRSTDIFF_EOF
cat > $P/overlay.json <<'MORPH_CONF_EOF'
{"Replace":{"calc/clamp_value_examples_test.go":""}}
MORPH_CONF_EOF
cat > $P/full.json <<'MORPH_CONF_EOF'
{"Replace":{}}
MORPH_CONF_EOF
echo '== build'; go build -overlay $P/overlay.json ./calc
echo '== vet'; E=0; go vet -overlay $P/overlay.json ./calc || E=1
echo '== gofmt'; F=$(gofmt -l calc/percent_of.go 2>&1) || true; [ -z "$F" ] || { echo "gofmt -l lists: $F"; gofmt -d calc/percent_of.go 2>&1 | head -60; E=1; }
echo '== guard'; node $P/guard.mjs src calc/percent_of.go
echo '== probe'; cat > calc/percent-of_probe_test.go <<'MORPH_PROBE_EOF'
package calc
MORPH_PROBE_EOF
go test -count=1 -overlay $P/overlay.json -run '^TestProbe' ./calc > $P/gt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^--- FAIL' $P/gt.log; then awk '/^--- FAIL/{p=1} p' $P/gt.log | grep -vE '^(ok[[:space:]]|PASS$|FAIL$)' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/gt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/gt.log; exit 1; }
rm -f calc/percent-of_probe_test.go
[ "$E" = 0 ] || { echo "== vet or gofmt failed (see above); every step between it and here passed"; exit 1; }
echo '== full'; go test -count=1 -overlay $P/full.json ./... > $P/gt.log 2>&1 || { if grep -q '^--- FAIL' $P/gt.log; then awk '/^--- FAIL/{p=1} p' $P/gt.log | grep -vE '^(ok[[:space:]]|PASS$|FAIL$)' | head -200; else tail -60 $P/gt.log; fi; node $P/firstdiff.mjs $P/gt.log; exit 1; }
echo '== frozen'; git diff --quiet HEAD -- go.mod internal || { echo "changed outside the targets: $(git diff --name-only HEAD -- go.mod internal | tr "\n" " ")"; exit 1; }
X=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vxF -e calc/percent_of.go || true); [ -z "$X" ] || { echo "files left in the tree: $X"; exit 1; }
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc
